name: Long Blade: Perish
descriptionTemplate: Counts as a "Strike". Deal [Damage:Arg1] DMG to all enemies [Arg3] times, which enjoys a [Arg2]% {STR} Bonus. For each "Strike" played this turn, the next {Long Blade: Perish} costs 1 less Arithmetica.
lore:
The heaviest, hardest fragment of Leviathan's skull was ground into a long blade, which she named <Italic:Perish>.
The great blade sweeps forth in an arc like the swing of a whale's tail, its crushing weight obliterating all in her path.
<Italic:Drink my blood and feast on my life,> said Lotan.
<Italic:Then... let all living things fall beneath your unstoppable arc.>
